Emily Chang meets artificial intelligence pioneer Fei-Fei Li to discuss her innovations in the field, her $1 billion startup World Labs and why she thinks the future of AI lies beyond chatbots.

Chris is helping at the Marlin Coast veterinary hospital in Cairns, and his first patient is a rare Fijian iguana Called Ako. The Iguana hasn't been himself and isn't eating properly. Chris needs to do an x-ray to try to work out what's going on. The results reveal a massive bladder stone inside the small animal, and he needs immediate surgery.

A frail joey orphan's brought in after his mum was hit by a car. Sandy's determined to give the little battler a chance, and Chris faces a challenge repairing his broken leg—it's heart-stopping when he finds if the risky surgery worked.
A tense night as Chris fights to save a policeman's poisoned pet, rescues a malnourished penguin that washed up onshore and operates on a young pup with a disintegrating leg.

Chris confronts a bizarre and shocking act of cruelty as a 12-year-old cat is deliberately dumped in the Bondi surf and left to die. There's also a depressed parrot caught in a bizarre love triangle, and can Lisa help a beautiful Samoyed survive a killer tick bite?

A groundbreaking operation is happening at the Bondi clinic: Elroy, the out-of-control bulldog is being desexed, and Chris is about to give him the very latest fake silicone testicles direct from the United States. Lisa hopes a blood transfusion can save a senior citizen. There are some very different patients including a sick owl spreading some nasty bugs and a turtle that's wandered way off track.

On this episode you will lose your heart to a brave golden retriever and her devoted owner. Rosie has severely deformed legs and only major surgery can save her life. How will owner Angus find the money and will the operation work? Chris also introduces us to one of Bondi's most delightful dog-loving eccentrics, and a cutting-edge solution for a record-breaking goat.
Dr Chris desperately fights to save the life of an innocent hit and run victim. Lisa helps little Zoe battle a poisonous snake bite. And, a lorikeet learns to fly again.

A much-loved Labrador is in trouble after a head on collision with a car and Lisa is in a race against time to find the cause of a mystery illness that is threatening the life of a five-month-old kitten. As well, Chris heads to the bush and gets called out to help with a difficult birth.

It's an unforgettable story as Chris takes home a fragile baby kangaroo with the odds against him: will the joey make it without his mum? Plus, a helping hand for a puppy with a life-threatening problem. And Chris confronts his archenemy: a chihuahua with a mean streak.
Follow Chris behind bars and meet three beautiful pups who are changing prisoners' lives. Lisa struggles to save the life of a pregnant beagle. And, a bunny brings the Bondi vet to tears.

So ugly he’s cute! Meet sharpei puppy, Mr Wilson who is running the risk of going blind because of the massive folds of fat that hang over his eyes. Chris is hoping an eyelift will allow Mr Wilson to finally see the world.

Chris tackles a tricky rescue—a mother duck and her three ducklings are stuck in a rubbish-filled pool at a building site. One duckling's already died, and catching these submersive birds won't be easy.
An eight month old kitten’s back legs have been shattered by a deliberate act of cruelty. Can Chris save eight month old Blackie?

Two peregrine falcons that live at the top of a high rise shopping center mall in busy Bondi Junction have been struck down with a mystery illness. Can Chris find the answer and return the beautiful birds to their penthouse home.

Chris faces one of his most traumatic nights when Bella the pug is rushed in. She's in labour with six huge pups, and during an emergency caesarean, Chris and his team battle to save the babies and critical Bella.

Extreme cold. Cosmic rays. A thin CO2 atmosphere. If that is what awaits us on Mars, why are we so fascinated with journeying to The Red Planet? Will mankind ever set foot on Mars? Will humans ever live there?

We all know that the earth is experiencing an energy crisis. We are using so much energy that our planet is reaching its limits. The perfect energy source would need to be inexhaustible yet protect the earth and climate. But where do we find it?

Throughout history, human society has run on trade, and trade moved on the oceans. The innovations that allowed faster and more accurate oceanic travel revolutionized the world. New inventions now help people and goods move on the water faster for recreation and commerce.

Low-ranking British pro Peter Colt is inspired to greatness in his last Wimbledon tournament when he starts dating American golden girl Lizzie Bradbury.

After his younger brother dies in an accident, the dreams of an accomplished sailor die with him. The two brothers meet in the hour before each sunset, but when a former classmate returns, he must decide whether to let romance help him move on.
Overstressed New Yorkers think they've found the answer to their problems when they join a counterculture community where the only rule is to be one's self.

A struggling matchmaker is hired by a king to find his son a suitable wife in time for a national celebration. As the clock ticks toward the deadline, the matchmaker finds him the perfect wife, only to realise she's fallen in love with him.
A jilted newlywed whose wife has been unfaithful decides to start all over again with a waitress he knew at school.
Set on a Greek island, a young woman who is about to be married suspects that any one of three men could be her father. She invites them all to her wedding without telling her mother.
While attending their son's college graduation, a divorced couple reignite the spark in their relationship.

At the end of the 19th century, a poor Irishman heads for the New World in the hope of becoming rich. He meets a wealthy and beautiful woman, and together they struggle before reaching their paradise in Oklahoma.
An ousted sports agent attempts to rebuild his career with the help of a loyal accountant and an egotistical athlete.
A year in the life of a neurotic thirty-something who resolves to take control of her life once and for all.

p.t: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
p.d: Weeks after becoming an item with dependable Mark Darcy, hapless Bridget gets cold feet and takes a new job alongside devious former boss Daniel.
Befuddled mum-to-be Bridget Jones must figure out which of the two men in her life is the father of her child.
An original comedy musical about two teenage girls attending a debutante ball in a small rural town.
Two energy drink salesmen play the role of big brothers to fulfil a community service obligation, which quickly becomes a pint-sized hassle as they learn kids can be unpredictable.
As war rages in Europe, a Nazi-scalping squad of American soldiers, known to their enemy as The Basterds, is on a daring mission to take down the leaders of the Third Reich.
Lydia Tar is an iconic musician, considered one the greatest living composer-conductors. This film examines the changing nature of power, its impact, and durability in our modern world.
An apocalyptic zombie uprising gives Shaun and his mates a night from hell when they meet at the local pub and find themselves fighting off hordes of the brain-hungry undead in this horror comedy.
In 19th-century France, Jean Valjean, who for decades has been hunted by the ruthless policeman Javert after breaking parole, agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter.
A secret agent is sent to Sydney to find and destroy a genetically modified disease called Chimera.
When an elite team of mercenaries breaks into a family compound on Christmas Eve, a disgruntled Santa Claus must take them out to save both the hostages and his Holiday.
Caretakers at a California horse ranch encounter a mysterious force that affects human and animal behaviour.
Discovering covert and faulty intelligence causes a U.S. Army officer to go rogue as he hunts for Weapons of Mass Destruction in an unstable region.
An experiment with dinosaurs created from DNA becomes a disaster when sabotage sets the prehistoric monsters loose in an island theme park.

p.t: Indiana Jones And The Last Crusade
p.d: In this third instalment of the great adventure saga, Indy is on a treacherous quest for the Holy Grail, complicated by a sexy woman with a fatal flaw: she's a Nazi agent.
Two young men in World War I set out to capture the lives, voices and music of their fellow American soldiers.

S1 E3There are places that take you back in time - like Morro do Moco, Angola's highest mountain, where you'll find a community disconnected from the rest of the world, living as they did a century ago. To get there, surfer and storyteller João Kopke went through several realities very different from his own.

p.t: Camp Woodward: Music Making, Awards and Pro's Teaching
p.d: S3 E7Problem child Sean Ricany learns some humbling lessons from BMX legend, Jamie Bestwick, while Jovon discovers the camp's music studio, and Zane premieres his zombie movie.

p.t: Camp Woodward: Giving Back and Giving In
p.d: S3 E8The final episode of Camp Woodward concludes with all of the campers paying it forward to the camp and other kids, each in their own way. Then, Sean, Jovon, and Zane all ride the Mega Ramp together in a unity session.

S1 E5Steve Caballero reflects on life beyond skateboarding, from the final Combi Pool Party to new passions in motocross, art and music. At 60, Cab shares how skating shaped his path and how bands like Faction and Urethane keep his creative fire alive.

S1 E1Portraits follows Aaron Jaws Homoki beyond the biggest drops, exploring his Arizona roots, local skate scene and life off the board. From choosing home over California to reflecting on injuries, friendships and purpose, Jaws opens up about what still drives him.

S1 E2Portraits dives into the world of Chris Russell, where chaos, discipline and progression go hand in hand. From skateboarding and surfing roots to jiujitsu and strength training, Chris shares how balance, focus and personal growth keep pushing him forward on and off the board.

S1 E3Greyson Fletcher lives loud and skates even louder. This Portrait dives into his explosive mindset, surf-rooted upbringing and raw approach to skating, from Burnside sessions to his take on skate culture, social media and living life at full speed.

p.t: The Standard Snowboard Show: Frederik Kalbermatten
p.d: S3 E3Growing up in a small town that does not allow automobiles and living at the base of the resort does have its advantages. Surrounded by the tallest mountains in the Alps, Frederik Kalbermatten feels right at home in Saas Fe Switzerland. Known for his graceful air style and fluidity, Frederik delivers some of the most inspiring snowboarding in this episode. This show travels with Frederik to some of the best places to ride around the globe from Saas Fe Switzerland, Lake Tahoe, Alaska, Bella Coola and Terrace B.C. Canada.

p.t: The Standard Snowboard Show: David Benedek
p.d: S3 E4Check out the German freestyle snowboard sensation David Benedek. David talks about his early days riding in contests and on rails, along with filming parts with Standard Films and Robot Food. Riding, directing and producing snowboard videos, David Benedek is the new era of professional snowboarders. This episode consists all of the best footage of David shot to date from all past and present film projects along with a guest appearance by Jussi Oksanen.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Deep Inside
p.d: S5 E14The Danny and The Dingo discuss the entertaining aspects of making television while traveling around the world with their friends.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Launching In Aspen
p.d: S1 E1The gang kicks off the tour with Danny competing at the X-Games in Aspen, Colorado.  We are introduced to Kevin Casillo, Kirsten, Danny, The Dingo, and Big Vern, their dog.  In an unfortunate turn of events, Danny breaks his hand and must go to the hospital.  Meanwhile, Dingo is busy teaching a Playboy Playmate how to snowboard.  The gang gets the RV stuck, but manages to make it to Spirit Mountain for the first Grenade Strikes Back amateur competition.  Here 16-year-old Joey Dryer emerges as the winner and earns a ticket to the 4/20 Grenade Games.

S3 E6Brazilian Caio Ibelli shares his surfing background and how he became a top WSL World Championship competitor. The highly skilled regular-footer talks about being a late bloomer from an inland town, dealing with expectations and losses, and how he had his best year ever without even being ranked on the Tour.

S3 E4In 2008 Brazilian free surfer Bruno Santos surprised the world when, as a wildcard, he defeated the experienced WSL Championship Tour surfers to take the win at the fabled Teahupoo break, in Tahiti. From then on, his reputation as a master barrel rider has only grown. In this exclusive interview, Santos examines his journey.

p.t: Sebastian Zietz and Friends Set Sail and Score Prime Mentawai Islands Surf
p.d: Surf star Sebastian Zietz gathers underground talent for an epic trip to Indonesia's Mentawai Islands. With raw skill, big waves, and laid-back vibes, this crew rips through pristine surf breaks, sharing laughs, BBQs, and insane sessions in this unforgettable adventure.

The Ghost Hunters head to New England to investigate the historic 1875 Inn, where a series of tragic fires may have trapped the souls of its guests within its walls. Then, the crew heads to New Jersey to investigate a historic landmark built by one of America's founding fathers.
TAPS visits the location of the “shot heard round the world” at the Colonial Inn in Concord, Massachusetts.

TAPS is checking out the Rose Island Lighthouse off of Newport, R.I. where there's some unusual activity going on. Then later the team hits the world famous Baseball Hall of Fame in Cooperstown, where supposedly some famous athletes just can't seem to move on.

Jason, Grant and the TAPS team travels to St. Louis, Missouri, to investigate a mansion that was the generational home of the Lemp family, and the site where three of its members committed suicide in the span of only two generations.

Jason, Grant and the rest of the TAPS team travels to Alton, Illinois, to investigate the possibility of paranormal activity inside the former Milton School building, where the spirits of a murdered girl and her killer are believed to reside.
On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Ohio and to the Thurber house, the home of author James Thurber, who wrote The Night the Ghost Got In based off his paranormal experiences there.
On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS returns to Mansfield, Ohio to investigate the Bissman Building, where the current manager, Ellis Byrd, was nearly choked to death by a black mist.
On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS starts out at the Ulster County Jail in Kingston, NY, where inmates and personal have both witnessed activity.
The Taps team heads to Beardslee Castle in Little Falls, NY, which is a hometurned into a restaurant/ bar that has lots of interesting claims.
The Taps heads to Fort William Henry located in Lake George, New York, where Ghost Hunters Academy winner Adam Berry joins the team.
TAPS travels to Alabama to investigate Sloss Furnaces, a 50-acre industrial plantoperating from 1882 until the 1970s.
The Ghost Hunters enlist the help of Bravo's The Real Housewives of Atlanta as they embark on this week's investigation.
The Christmas Farm Inn in Jackson, N.H., and the Old Stone Fort in Schoharie, N.Y., are probed.

The TAPS crew is summoned to the city of Alexandria, Louisiana, by residents claiming that they have a haunted hotel, tavern and restaurant that need to be investigated; the town hosts an event for the ghost hunters to submit their findings.

The crew investigates the infamous Pennhurst Asylum in Pennsylvania, which is said to have a section in which ghosts can be heard playing the piano and a tunnel system where visions of dismembered torsos and a female ghost have been seen.

Legendary coach Joe Finn attempts to reconnect with his son David by forming a new baseball league designed to reinvigorate an underdog little league team and inspire Dads to get involved.

p.t: Home Is Where the Heart Is
p.d: Two sisters return to their childhood homes to renovate it; they aim to transform the space into a new setting for memories, rooted in nostalgia.
Witness intense moments as we follow individuals who have risked their lives, and others that have lost loved ones. You will be encouraged as we witness God move extraordinarily.
We like to call it 'soul food'. LIFE TV uses creative illustration, real life stories and biblical teaching to encourage and help viewers discover a greater purpose to their lives.

p.t: Turning Point With Dr. David Jeremiah
p.d: Continue to focus your mind on heaven through meaningful worship with musical guests Michael Sanchez, Jordan Smith, and others.

The In Touch program reaches the world with the Gospel with messages that tackle such issues as parenting, finances, personal crises, emotions, and relationships. Dr. Stanley fervently believes the Bible to be the inerrant Word of God, a belief strongly reflected in his teaching. Dr Charles Stanley is the author of more than 50 books.
Gary Hoogvliet, a very tall man, interviews interesting folk, not quite as tall as he, but nevertheless with fascinating and inspiring stories to tell.

Demetri Chicopoulos (Robert Krantz) is living a charmed life. He is the host of his hit, daytime talk show, Daytime with Demetri. However, we soon learn that with a recent divorce and the passing of his mother, Demetri's life is more pain than charmed. In a prayerful moment, Demetri kneels and asks God if he could just relive one week of his life. He knows things would turn out differently. Demetri rises and suddenly meets... his Guardian Angel (Tom Arnold). Well, not exactly the type of Guardian Angel one hopes for. The Guardian Angel tells Demetri God heard his prayer... Demetri will get to relive one week of his life. What happens next will change Demetri's life forever.

The best-known Christian evangelist of the 20th century, Billy Graham gained world attention in 1949 with a tent revival in downtown Los Angeles that was scheduled for three weeks and lasted six. In the ensuing 55 years and more, 'Billy Graham Crusades' consistently drew audiences of thousands to arenas and stadiums throughout the world.'Classic Crusades' presents the best of the last 35 years of Billy Graham that brought the message of salvation through Jesus Christ to the world. World renowned actors, singers, athletes and ministers share the platform with Dr. Graham. Also often features the famous sounds of the Billy Graham Choir, George Beverly Shea and Cliff Barrows for an hour of blessing and inspiration to all who watch.
Dani, an enthusiastic EMT rookie, faces challenges with her new co-worker, Tim, in the EMS world by navigating a prank-filled welcome, their first emergencies, and an unexpected competition.
Paramedics Dani and Tim navigate new challenges on the job and personal struggles. Dani's mistake and Duke's emotional toll impact their professional and personal lives.
Dani and Griffin grow closer after her failure. She works hard to improve while Tim grows concerned about Dani's potential new romance. Tiffany suspects Duke's drinking as other EMS struggles unfold.
The team celebrates Tim's solo save. Tensions rise with Tim's success, Duke and Dani's personal struggles continue to unfold, and chief Scotty faces a dilemma: the final decision on who gets the job.
Dani reconnects with Ashley who helps her heal and the EMS team saves one of their own. Dani, with her new outlook, is challenged with an intense emergency and Scotty must make his final decision.
Host Michael Bonacini dives into Campania's coastal cuisine, starting with a grilled Caprese salad from Capri, then serving bold flavors with a classic spaghetti puttanesca.

Chef Michael Bonacini explores Emilia-Romagna's iconic cuisine, making Mortadella Mousse on Modena Flatbreads, Tortellini in Broth, Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce, and Rice Custard Cake with Cherry Glaze.

Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes from the coastal region of Calabria. He prepares a light brioche with gelato, a spicy sausage and ricotta pasta, and a hearty lamb au gratin with peas and asparagus.

Chef Michael Bonacini explores Lombardy's luxurious cuisine, preparing stuffed squash blossoms with parmesan, anchovies and nutmeg, followed by a rich saffron Risotto Milanese—a feast for the eyes and taste buds.

Chef Michael Bonacini explores Umbria's lush landscape and seasonal ingredients. He serves fried spicy tomato flatbread, then highlights an Umbrian speciality—black truffles with light and fluffy gnocchi.

Appreciating island culture, Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his antipasto of stuffed snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate lobster spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region.
Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of Friuli Venezia Guilia with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms.
Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini shows takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.
Chef Michael Bonacini makes Pollo Alla to showcase the bold and filling flavors of the southern region of Basilicata, Italy.
Chef Michael Bonacini cooks four of his favorite dishes, and he shares secrets of the mountainous region of Molise, Italy.

Michael Bonacini draws inspiration from the Italian region of Valle d'Aosta, which is a mountainous area near France and Switzerland, as he demonstrates how to prepare several hearty dishes, including chestnut fettuccine.
Chef Michael Bonacini explores Tuscany's fine cuisine with four dishes: Many Mushroom soup with fried sage, Lamb Ragu over pici noodles, Porchetta-Style Duck, and a smooth Creamy Coffee Custard.

Host Michael Bonacini explores the Venetian region's bounty from sea to land — serving soft shell crab with tangy sundried tomato aioli, radicchio risotto, pancetta-wrapped snapper with pea mash, and a giant almond crumb biscuit to finish.

Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Michael explores its native ingredients through some of his favorite Puglian meals. First up, he serves crispy fried mussels, followed by tomato and burrata risotto.
Chef Michael Bonacini explores Sicilian cuisine, where simplicity meets intensity. He kicks off with folded flatbread with ricotta and fennel seeds, followed by broccoli and sausage rigatoni.
Paranormal activity in Lisa Blakely's home puts her son in harm's way, a shadowy figure terrorises a young boy, and Micky Bailey falls victim to an evil spirit intent on inflicting harm.

Visit the chilling Iowa location of a gruesome ax murder with an adventurer, who experiences a haunting night he’ll never forget. Go for a regrettable walk through some sinister woods in the middle of England and explore a haunted shop.

Step inside the UK’s most haunted house, 30 East Drive in Pontefract, where the demonic Black Monk is reported to linger. Then come into contact with otherworldly beings who could finally prove that UFOs exist.
Three explorers brave terrifying energy in an abandoned UK asylum and get more than they bargained for. Then a door-slamming, doorbell-ringing phantom terrorises a New York family.
Sinister ocean sounds shock a Massachusetts fisherman to his core. Explore an eerie abandoned mine and meet a UK paranormal enthusiast with an unbelievable collection of otherworldly photos.

Stephanie's life is turned upside down when dark energies enter her home and target her children in the dead of night. In Darlington, a couple claim they can summon UFOs at will - it's all unexplained and all caught on camera.
A poltergeist attaches itself to a sensitive young girl, while a shadow man terrorises a boy and a demonic entity violently attacks a teenager.
Dark spirits plunge their victims into a sinister supernatural realm, while a malicious entity stalks a young girl.
The paranormal leaves its mark figuratively and literally on innocent victims while a brother and sister encounter a malicious entity in the basement.

A couple is looking for a historic home in the country with a porch and plenty of green space. Ben and Erin transform their new home into a classic, dogtrot-style house full of historic charm and Southern touches.
A couple wants a vacation home that's big enough to entertain but manageable to maintain. After showing them a 1920s cottage and a 1912 Craftsman, Ben and Erin create the perfect getaway for them.

Professors Jay and Rhonda are interested in historic preservation and look for an old home of their own; Erin and Ben revive a 1920s Craftsman cottage that stays true to its character, including original woodwork.
Dave and Jenny travel to Italy to take on their biggest project yet, helping friends who've poured their life savings into a Tuscan farmhouse rental.
We catch up with Ranald and Marjorie who were looking for a house with more space for their grandchildren to stay, and Laura and Linda who needed a place to suit the whole family.

David and Sarah are in love with MtTamborine, the place they were married 22 years ago. They're now about to build a home-away-from-home there, on lush mountain acreage boasting a rainforest and creek.
Steven and Theresa own a dated six-bedroom home which has been on the market for three years with three agents. They need the team's help as they've already lowered the price.

p.t: Love It Or List It Australia
p.d: The competition is on, not just between homeowners, but with Andrew & Neale in this episode. Will Team List it win with Skye & Andrew finding a new home or Neale & Jacob's team with a renovation?
27-year-old Josh rushed in with head and spinal injuries after coming off his motorbike. 10-month old Phoenix is in paediatrics after he was found sucking on a bleach tablet.
The celebs goggle at Countdown, Scam Interceptors, Best of the World with Antoni Porowski, Rivals, Swipe Right for Sperm, I Will Find You, and BBC News coverage of the World Cup.

Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badger's risky dance with a deadly snake.

Go up against Australia's wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroo's deadly boxing moves and the redback spider's precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

Experience the north Atlantic's intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

After the dry season lowers the waters, siblings Kimba and Maya risk crossing the river to search for their parents. They run the gauntlet of the densest populations of crocs and hippos in Africa, and face an even greater threat on the other side.

When a baby mink is abandoned in a store, the team gets to work on some behavioural training. But will this sweet little one be tough enough for the wild when they're done? Visit with a mange-afflicted coyote who's enjoying some alone time to heal.

Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, an animal shelter puppy that helps a captive cheetah cub get ready for the wild, and an injured monkey who wins over a pack of unfriendly dogs and a lonely mongoose that enjoys foraging with a flock of sheep.

Hit the road with Dr. Scott and rookie vet Dr. Riaz as they make a house call to treat two bad-news chipmunks. Then get to know a cat who may have cancer and a cute puppy whose nose problems land him in the plastic surgery ward.

An exotic dog named Paloma meets Dr. Scott and his team, who must deal with her tricky past; Bella the bulldog hopes to find her new forever home; a litter of feral kittens arrive at the clinic to receive treatment for their worms.

Stay grounded as the vets try to help ailing airborne animals. Witness the unusual measures they take to help a galah with a broken leg and a badly clipped wing, then examine the X-rays of a limping sugar glider who’s lost the ability to soar.

Celebrate as Allie cashes in on a horse while Tammy shocks the barn by announcing her wedding is next weekend. Join a whirlwind dress-shopping spree and watch Megan take over Allie's lesson with Courtney—with less than stellar results.

Get in the swing of wedding prep with Tammy, left holding the bag when her fiancé takes off golfing with his buddies. Check on Megan and Jamie's big horse sale, and watch in horror as Tammy's fiancé forgets his vows.
Alex acts up during Megan's lesson. Allie's ex Drake stirs things up with talk of a partnership and a new barn. Meanwhile, the women of Wendigo Farms celebrate success and plan ahead.

Bounce around with the Scaifes, who are on the lookout for a high-energy puppy to keep up with their three busy kiddos. Take a peek at Australian labradoodles, bouviers des Flandres, and miniature schnauzers, then see which breed steals their hearts.

Deal with a terrier’s diabetes diagnosis and see how Dr. Scott help this ailing pooch through the toughest battle of his life. Experience an emotional reunion with Emma before the clinic bands together for an unforgettable emergency.
Join Emma on a night-time stroll with a sick aardvark, discover an elephant's remarkable hearing with Jenna and Sean, and see Josie's treatment plan for a vervet monkey hit by a car.

Brace for big challenges as Harriet makes a house call to an elephant whose leg has been wounded by a poacher’s trap. Assess the nine orphaned baby monkeys who’ve landed on Debbie’s doorstep and see Emma mother three-week-old Hector the hippo.
A bobcat kitten is desperate for Hope's assistance, but the little orphan has a way of creating some full-size problems all by itself.

Chris is confronted with an unusual patient, an albino echidna. But there's a question mark over whether the extremely rare echidna is a male or a female. It will have to be anaesthetised so Chris can investigate.

Tiny Amari has been born with a badly twisted back leg. At just 3 days old she's one of the youngest kittens Chris has ever seen at the clinic. Amari needs a series of splints to try to save her leg, and give her a second chance.

In a second duct tape stick-tacular, Adam and Jamie set up a challenge that will take the tape's strength, adhesion and load-bearing capability to the absolute limit. Meanwhile, Kari, Grant and Tory are all wrapped up busting duct tape automotive myths.

On this wet and wild episode, Adam and Jamie tackle the biggest, dirtiest, most vertigo inducing build in Mythbusters history while Kari, Tory and Grant deliver the goods, to find out if taking only right turns can save you gas.

On this explosive episode of MythBusters, the whole team gets hot under the collar of what is no doubt a pyromaniacs dream. That’s because while Adam and Jamie literally play with fire, Kari, Grant and Tory are playing with fireworks.
On this frightening episode of MythBusters, you’ll want to duck for cover as the team tests myths that you make you afraid. Very afraid.
Are the Storm Chasers' vehicles fit to withstand force 5 tornado speeds? Is it possible to build a personal tornado protection device?

On this episode of Mythbusters, we’re testing two shaggy-dog tales that both put our crime-fighting canines to the ultimate test. In Hair of the Dog, Adam and Jamie hook once again up with a hound called Morgan, (and his best friend Matt), to revisit a myth they’ve tried once before: to see if an escaped convict really can outsmart and outrun his pursuers.
On this episode of MythBusters, Adam and Jamie are on an archery odyssey, while there’s no rest for Kari, Grant and Tory take a ride on the wild side for a dangerous driving myth.

The guys test whether a person's feet really do turn cold when that person is apprehensive or nervous about something; the team throws poop at a running fan in order to see just how far the substance will be hurled through the air.

Stay in your lane for this episode of MythBusters, because Jaime and Adam are putting the pedal to the metal.... backwards. And if that wasn’t enough for you then Kari, Grant and Tory turf some surf-boards... with a little help from an SUV.
On this episode of MythBusters, Adam and Jamie make the magic happen, while Kari, Grant and Tory strain their brains for a pop culture myth.
Can a car's tire pressure affect its fuel efficiency? Can a laptop stop a bullet from point-blank range? Can a hair weave stop a .40 caliber bullet? Can a fridge door stop a round of 9mm bullets?
In “Upside Down Underwater Car”, Jamie bravely risks Adam’s life in a revisit of one of the most spectacular, harrowing and successful myths in the show’s history.
The MythBusters bug out in this special, testing whether 1,000 bees can actually lift a laptop off a log—or if it's just a flight of fancy.
On this special episode of Mythbusters, Seth Rogen, star and writer of the upcoming superhero blockbuster ‘The Green Hornet,’ joins the team for two blockbusting stories.
On this extra-special episode of MythBusters, Adam and Jamie tackle a viewer request by the biggest viewer of all - none other than The President of the United States of America, Barack Obama.

Explore a region that provides shelter to a wide array of life, despite its harsh conditions. Whether burrows of nocturnal bat-eared foxes or massive colonies of harvester ants, this ecosystem offers a wealth of resources to its native wildlife.
Tanzania's vast Ngorongoro Crater is in many ways a perfect home for wildlife. However, its isolation also threatens their futures.

From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australia’s most recognised imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. But how did the arid centre of the continent come to be?

Volcanologist Tom Pfeiffer leads an expedition to some of Indonesia's most remote and rarely visited volcanos, including the extremely active volcano of Batu Tara.
Discover the story of Aztec warrior Popocatepetl - a giant active volcano - who erupts to wake his princess Iztaccihuatl, a neighbouring ice-capped volcano.
Head to Indonesia, where the toxic air in some regions is 40 times above safety levels. Elsewhere, small volcanoes are so active they erupt every 15 minutes.

Survival in the forest means maintaining a delicate balance between growth and destruction and death and rebirth - a forest should be in a constant state of regeneration. When trees get too tall they block all the sunlight from hitting the ground, which means grasses and smaller shrubs can’t grow, diminishing habitat for animals like elk, moose, caribou, and wolves.

A close look is taken at the Rocky Mountains to reveal how many animals rely on social groups to increase their chances of survival among the harsh elements, even as no two animal groups structure their group living norms in the same way.
For people who live on active volcanoes, life has an element of impermanence to it. There is always the fear that one day their turn will come, and their home will be in the path of the volcano.
In Hampton, New Brunswick, the deer population is running wild. Sightings have reached an all-time high and residents fear the overpopulation may be at its tipping point.
In the surrounding waters of Brier Island live an incredible number of humpback whales and dolphins. It's an incredible sight.

Africa - a continent teeming with life. While its animal aristocrats are the most familiar, lurking in the shadows is a diversity of reptiles. They’ve conquered just about every habitat and have evolved a remarkable array of adaptations that make them the undisputed masters of the underworld.
When film executive Gavin Smith vanishes, Los Angeles detectives search for clues amid reported sightings and suspicious circumstances.
A woman continues searching for answers after the investigation into her daughter's murder goes cold.
The parents of a missing South Carolina woman speak out about her disappearance.
When two tragic deaths occur within one week of each other in a wealthy city in California, families begin to wonder what happened inside a beachfront mansion.
A former marine who once was the hero for a woman in an abusive marriage may have let his desire to help go too far.
An in-depth look at the journalists who exposed the dangers of cult leader Reverend Jim Jones; interviews with witnesses to murders carried out by Jones' followers.
When a young mother disappears after leaving her infant in the care of her local pastor and his wife, Florida detectives search for her for five years, uncovering a web of secrets and lies.
